title: FNR3 PSP generic-event to AEMS runtime pipeline
confidence: CONFIRMED for control/dataflow and layouts unless individually marked

relocation_context.note: The state-table addresses below are PSP-relocated references targeting program segment 1. Raw pre-relocation offsets are retained for reproducibility.

mapping_key_packer.layout: little-endian 32-bit: +0x00 u16 token/key, +0x02 u8 selector B, +0x03 u8 selector A
mapping_key_packer.note: 0x0049B61C constructs +0x1C through this helper from parsed EVT fields.

behavior: resolves the listener's packed mapping key through 0x004970EC
reads mapping-record +0x0B as the number of 32-bit gameplay-payload words required by this mapping
allocates 4 + payload_words*4 bytes through the registered AEMS allocator
copies the 4-byte mapping key to packet +0x00
copies exactly payload_words words from the generic named-event payload to packet +0x04
submits ownership to 0x004974CC; failed submission frees the packet immediately

state_layout.+0x000..+0x01F: 8 x u32 active-packet counts, one per AEMS group
state_layout.+0x020..+0x03F: 8 x s32 current/selected admitted-slot indices; -1 means none

fields.+0x00: scheduler time/tick captured from 0x0049B528 (behavior confirmed; exact time-unit name unresolved)
fields.+0x04: u16 sequence/generation value used to order events sharing a time value

behavior: rejects reentrant submission through a global guard
retrieves the AEMS group index via 0x00497140 and chooses one of 16 admitted slots with 0x00497364
stores scheduler ordering data, mapping pointer and packet ownership in the selected slot
increments the owning group's active count and records its current slot
if mapping-record byte +0x0A bit 5 is set, immediately invokes the group's processing path at 0x00497E48
release_behavior: frees the owned packet if present
clears the group's current-slot index if this slot was current
decrements the group's active count without allowing it to remain negative

context_layout.+0x04: selected parsed AEMS event/variant object pointer
context_layout.+0x0A: number of 12-byte execution descriptors, derived from selected object byte +0x02 >> 2
context_layout.+0x0B: mapping-record gameplay-payload word count (source for owned packet-copy allocation)
context_layout.+0x0C: owned copy of the mapping/gameplay packet
context_layout.+0x10: start of up to 12 execution descriptors

fields.+0x00: source object/pointer selected during mapping evaluation
fields.+0x08: u16 derived selector/value populated from source byte +0x0A and mapping state

execution_descriptor.semantic_boundary: The binary layout and population dataflow are confirmed; original field names are not.

packet_to_decoder.confidence: CONFIRMED as the admitted-packet mapping/condition evaluator; exact original symbol unknown
behavior: re-resolves the packet's 4-byte mapping key and AEMS group
evaluates mapping conditions and selects parsed event/variant objects
calls 0x00499CEC to materialize the owning group's 0xA0 decoder context
may create no active decoder context when mapping/conditions reject the packet
sequence: reset the group's existing decoder context with 0x00499BD0
if a decoder context became active, execute it through 0x00499E64
reconstructs the 4-byte mapping key from the decoder context's owned packet
calls 0x0049A5C0 with the resolved mapping record, selected event/variant object and mapping key
0x0049A5C0 constructs the already-recovered 0x20-byte AEMS->AuSpeechManager requests and invokes the registered speech callback
updates per-group execution accounting and resets the decoder context through 0x00499BD0
decoder_to_speech.downstream: 0x00137888 AuSpeechManager callback -> category 0/1/2 com/anc/trn routing -> speech-bank event record -> bank byte range

end_to_end_path: Fight Night generic named gameplay event
generic event listener installed from .evt data
speech data bank byte range playback
unresolved_boundary: Individual comevt.evt / ancevt.evt / trnevt.evt subscription names and their exact payload-word requirements are external-data facts not recoverable from BOOT.BIN alone.
The semantic names of several mapping-condition fields and execution-descriptor fields remain unresolved.
Exact spoken-clip identity for a given gameplay event requires the corresponding speech .evt/.hdr/.big data or a runtime capture.
